description: Caller is angry about a past bad experience — agent should acknowledge without over-apologising or blaming a technician it knows nothing about.

caller.opening: I am SO done with plumbers. The last guy left my bathroom a mess and never even fixed the leak. I don't even want to book with anyone anymore.
caller.persona: Diane Cho, angry about a previous plumber from a different company. Venting, sceptical, but does still need help. Softens slowly if handled well.

facts.name: Diane Cho
facts.problem: the kitchen faucet is the issue this time

caller.goal: vent about the last plumber, then reluctantly give your details so someone can come out.
